title: Miaomiao & Samsung connection
body:
When using the miaomiao reader on a Samsung S8, xDrip won't automatically update readings until a new pairing request is requested in the phones bluetooth settings. 

Have given xDrip as many privileges as I can but still won't update any readings following the initial backlog until a new pairing is requested.

comments.body:

The Galaxy S8 is reported to work well with miaomiao and pairing is not normally ever done with it.

I tried few versions in result with the same problem. 
Last version: 0acd72c-2018.05.11
Code: 1805112149
Downgradable to: 1603091400

I have the same problem with S7 after upgrade to Oreo. I am not able to have Connected in the connection status.

This is precisely the problem I am getting with my Google Pixel after updating the June 5th security patch. Although xDrip+ seems the miaomiao it now uses LimiTTer Collector rather than Tomato. I can't see any other changes. I had heard of someone else who tried tweaking some bluetooth settings in the Less common settings, Bluetooth settings and had some success. I will post exactly what he said in our Facebook group in the hopes it helps someone else and they can relay that information:

_"Hopefully it stays that way. the settings I changed are found by going into xDrips settings, Tap on Less Common Settings. In here, tick Aggressive service restarts. Then tap on advanced bluetooth settings and tick Bluetooth Watchdog, I unticked the G5 watchdog, since I am not using that one. untick Close GAT on BLE disconnect and tick Bluetooth wakelocks. Lastly, tick the xBridge+ Polling Mode and this should get you up and running. . Let me know if it works for you, but it is currently working for me under Android P beta. I didn't think of trying the bluetooth tweaks before I installed the beta to see if that would help."_
Same problems on Samsung A5 2017. Works for 1 or maybe 2 days, then its very unstable...

So we think we have determined what the problem might be and have a "reasonable" workaround for the short term. There seem to be several factors involved.

First of all I used the March 30th version of xDrip+ based on other things I have read - this version seems the most stable for this problem but no empirical data to back that up.

Second, I downloaded the nRF Connection for Android. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=no.nordicsemi.android.mcp&hl=en

It is necessary to establish a connect to the miaomiao using nRF. Once this has been done xDrip sees the miaomiao and connects via Tomato. 

Things should start to work on xDrip+

The caveat is if I stray out or range of Bluetooth range of my phone it drops the connection and I have to go through the process again - very flaky in my opinion. I have not explored nRF enough to see if it can continuously establish the connection without intervention but will poke around.

Mine was actually working fine until the June 5th, security patch of Android. If it was easily possible to downgrade my phone previous to the patch I wouldn't hesitate to do that but on a Pixel there is no easy provision to do that.

The problem seems to be with a change that has been made in Android with Bluetooth communicating with low energy devices. The phone on its own does not seem to be able to do it without some help - in this case nRF Connect.

I would be interested if this works for anyone else and if you can improve on the above.

I have the same problem with the recent nightly builds and was using the same workaround @gferrie mentioned for a while now. Initiating the BLE connection in another app works, even with latest nightly builds, but not reliably.

In my case it's certainly not related to the security patch of Android, as the newest security patch I have is from April 2018 and the problems started after updating to the nightly builds after March 30th.

I have so far tested the following android phones: Samsung Galaxy S7, Ulefone Armor 2, Huawei P20 lite. The behavior is the same across the board.

Hello, I'm having the same issue after update Oreo Android version. Thanks to @gferrie it was working but disconnecting most of the times. I experienced the same issue also with my WV Connect app for the car. I cleared the cache app in both apps and even the data in the storage part and now is working from the last 8 hours without disconnection, just in case it can helps

The steps to clear the cache:

If your device is on Nougat (7.0) or above:

1. From the home screen, select Applications. 
2. Select Settings.
3. Select Apps.
4. Select Menu.
5. Select Show system apps.
6. Select the application you'd like to clear.
7. Select Storage.
8. Select Clear cache.

I'm thinking now the miaomiao has something to do with the connection.  So my miaomiao broke and I had to go back to my old Blucon.  The connection is bonded and it's working flawlessly.  I mean perfect and it's been great for over two weeks.  So I'm thinking maybe it's the miaomiao that's the problem.

Anyone mind explaining what the difference is between LimiTTer and Tomato connection? Neither seem to work all that well but I am thinking Tomato is the default. I don't see anywhere where you can change or default to this? I am frankly so disappointed and frustrated with the miaomiao that I feel like running it over with the car. It worked so well when I first got it but not it, or something else, is incredibly flakey. I cannot wait for Abbott to come up with their own solution. I would gladly pay for it after the last month or so.

So recently upgraded my Google Pixel phone to Android P which was released a couple of days ago. I have lost the connection once in that time and it reconnected itself after a few minutes. I think this is finally a fix for this incredibly annoying problem. for what its worth.
Anyone have anything new to make it stable?  I think I am finally just going to give up on xdrip.

Hi, for me leoleezoom´s advice disable "Trust Auto-Connect"(Setting——> Less common settings ——>Bluetooth Settings——>Trust Auto-Connect(Turn it off!)), plus disabling "out of process libre algorithm"  ---->other misc options ----> out of process libre algorithm. Seem to work! Maybe you can try that if you did not already.

I am using the Abbot Freestyle Libre 14 days sensor in the US.  xDrip shows connected to the MiaoMiao, but I get no readings and the logs show "DexCollection Service We have all the data that we need 363 cgecjsyn_ok=false".  I have tried all the suggestions offered to no avail.  Very frustrated at this point.  I don't know if this is a MiaoMiao problem, an Android Problem, an App problem, or something else.  
I clicked on the "Upload logs" in xDrip, but I don't know where the logs go?

Thanks for any help which could be provided...

Steve Rogers
